notes: Mt Auburn east of Sinton, north edge of Eden Park. Sinton Av. is printed 'SINTON AV. (GRAND)', 50'; it continues south past Morris into the park (west line solid, east line dashed) to the bottom of the sheet. Nassau (printed 'NASSAU', 60'), recorded as 'Nassau Street' to match sheet 178. Fulton Av. (50') crosses Nassau and runs south to the park. St. James Av. (60') comes up from the park and ends at Nassau; north of Nassau the street continues as a separate, offset piece (St. James Av. on sheets 180/199) whose west building line is at x~3762 at the right edge, with a pipe at x~3790; its centre (about x 3850) falls at the very edge of the paper, so that T is not listed here (it is on sheet 180). Named 'St. James Avenue (south of Nassau)' / '(north of Nassau)' so the two offset pieces stay separate. East of St. James Av. the open ground between Nassau and the block at y~873 is the west end of the curving street that joins Alpine Pl. on sheet 180 (no name printed here). Bella Vista Pl. (from sheet 178) is drawn west of Sinton only as its two building lines, unlabelled width. Morris St. (printed 'MORRIS ST.') comes from the west and ends at Sinton. 'EDEN PARK TERRACE' printed below the row of houses 1-9 east of Sinton at Morris is the name of the row-house terrace along the park line, not a street; no south line of any roadway is drawn there, so no point is given. 'ST. JAMES PL.' is a court inside the block west of St. James Av., with houses 2-9 facing it from the west and houses on its north and south sides; the St. James Av. building line is drawn unbroken across its mouth, so it is listed under alleys (from its west end to St. James' west line), not as an intersection; width not printed.
